text: Qualified run-specific AR GLS without changing shared-coefficient GLS scope. Commits 6ae2afe (implementation, shared JVM/Scala.js tests, qualification receipt) and 219aa16 (clean-candidate evidence). Clean detached 6ae2afe passed scalafimCompileAll warning-clean; RunwiseGlsSuite 4/4 on JVM and 4/4 on Scala.js; fmriWorkflow 23 JVM and 19 Scala.js tests. Evidence covers unequal/gapped runs, independent segmented-whitening oracle, run-specific effects, fixed and estimated voxelwise AR, full covariance, chunk invariance, and explicit refusal of global pooling and patterned missing-data GLS.
